subject.title: [Feature]: Audit log for agent memory changes

question: What memory mutation audit contract should OpenClaw support for MEMORY.md and memory/*.md writes, including storage location, integrity model, redaction policy, and cause propagation?
rationale: The security value depends on tamper boundaries, privacy tradeoffs, and where the audit belongs across memory-core, plugin SDK seams, or external MCP/plugin packages, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Design first-class memory audit
options.body: Keep this issue open and specify the storage, integrity, redaction, and event schema before accepting an implementation.

options.title: Fold into persistent-state provenance
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/48509 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/48519 the architecture owner if maintainers want one durable-state provenance model for memory, files, preferences, and tasks.

options.title: External-only audit packages
options.body: Narrow or close core work only if maintainers decide current plugin/MCP surfaces are sufficient for memory-audit packages without new OpenClaw contracts.

recommendation.title: Design first-class memory audit
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and specify the storage, integrity, redaction, and event schema before accepting an implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already routed this issue as memory/security design and is the strongest recent routing candidate from discussion plus sampled memory-file history.
